import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Define paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.json"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.json"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = "./input/sampleSubmission.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_json(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_json(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# Feature columns (numeric + engineered)
feat_cols = [
    "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "post_was_edited",
    "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_user_flair",
]

# Add text columns for TF-IDF
text_cols = ["request_text_edit_aware"]

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df.copy()
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Convert boolean to numeric
for col in feat_cols:
    if col in X_train.columns and X_train[col].dtype == bool:
        X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype(int)

# Combine text and tabular features into a DataFrame for easy splitting
# Create tabular array
tabular_X = X_train[feat_cols].values
tabular_X = np.nan_to_num(tabular_X, nan=0)

# Fit TF-IDF on all training text data at once
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=100)
train_text_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df[text_cols[0]])

# Combine features for training
X_train_combined = np.hstack([tabular_X, train_text_tfidf.toarray()])

# Create proper train/validation split BEFORE any other operations
X_train_subset, X_val, y_train_subset, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train,
)

# Handle missing values (shouldn't have any now, but for safety)
X_train_subset = np.nan_to_num(X_train_subset, nan=0)
X_val = np.nan_to_num(X_val, nan=0)

# Train model only on training data
model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=10, random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train_subset, y_train_subset)

# Calculate validation AUC-ROC on held-out validation set (model never trained on this)
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {auc_val:.6f}")

# Predict on test data
test_ids = test_df["request_id"].values

# Prepare test features using SAME vectorizer (fit on train)
test_tabular = test_df[feat_cols].copy()
test_tabular = np.nan_to_num(test_tabular.values, nan=0)

test_text_flat = vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_cols[0]])

test_data = np.hstack([test_tabular.values, test_text_flat.toarray()])

test_probs = model.predict_proba(test_data)[:, 1]

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample submission format
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_ids, "requester_received_pizza": test_probs.round(6)}
)

# Save submission to CORRECT path
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)

print(f"Final Validation AUC-ROC on held-out set: {auc_val:.6f}")
